verdict.rationale: Exa's own SDK documents a published-date filter (startPublishedDate) on search, and results carry a publishedDate field. The llms.txt probe describes Exa as a real-time knowledge index it builds and maintains itself. However, the evidence shows only a start date, with no end date, relative recency window, or documented index refresh cadence. Missing for 10: end-date/range bounds and a recency or live-crawl option documented, concrete index update frequency, independent or hands-on corroboration of result freshness.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can get fresh results with date-range and recency filters backed by a frequently updated index
